hash_contract.capture_requirement: Every durable capture manifest must contain the matching protocol SHA-256.

research_question: Which forecasting system, as actually published during the 2026 Swedish election campaign, performed better?
excluded_question: Which mathematical model would win if both were retrospectively rerun with exactly the same information?

timing_eligibility.before_cutoff: TOO_EARLY_EXCLUDED; no durable real capture is permitted

comparison_time_semantics.rule: Compare what each system made public at the same wall-clock cutoff.
comparison_time_semantics.unchanged_content_on_consecutive_dates: Permitted and retained as distinct scheduled evidence; it is never silently copied by the benchmark.

election_simulator_selection.rule: Select the latest certified production generation that was durably committed at or before the benchmark cutoff.
required_conditions: generation generated_at_utc is at or before cutoff
the archive index and snapshot hashes validate
the Git commit first containing the immutable generation is at or before cutoff
model version, seed, input hashes, payload hash, and source commit are recorded
election_simulator_selection.draw_policy: Only exact joint draws exported from the same certified production SimulationResult, cryptographically linked to that generation and checked against its summaries and deterministic payload hash, are eligible. A separately configured benchmark rerun is prohibited.

hierarchy: official contemporaneous predictive draws whose parity with the public forecast is verified
official machine-readable published probabilities, quantiles, intervals, and point estimates
official webpage values with preserved raw evidence
required_provenance: relevant upstream repository/config commit if identifiable
botten_ada_evidence.verified_draws_definition: The archived official draw object is identified as election-day predictive draws and reproduces, within predeclared parsing tolerances, every simultaneously available public central forecast, compatible interval endpoint, and 4% threshold probability. Posterior parameter draws are not presumed to be predictive draws.
botten_ada_evidence.parity_rounding_rule: Tolerance only covers the last displayed decimal place: 0.05 percentage points for values shown to one decimal and 0.005 probability for values shown as whole percentages, plus 0.001 numerical slack.
forbidden_inference: inventing draws from quantiles or intervals
assuming a Gaussian law from plus/minus notation
constructing a joint distribution from marginals
treating a local reimplementation as Botten Ada's published forecast
carrying a prior capture forward after a source failure

source_failure_policy.durability: The scheduled failure record is itself the immutable capture and must not later be overwritten.
source_failure_policy.retry_rule: Retries may occur only before a durable slot is indexed. After a slot is indexed, all retries must fail closed.
source_failure_policy.freshness_rule: Preserve and report source timestamps and unchanged hashes. A genuinely available unchanged published forecast remains what the system said and is not replaced; SOURCE_STALE is used only when the official source marks the forecast obsolete or does not contain a current 2026 election forecast.

primary_scoring.availability_condition: Both systems have verified election-day joint predictive vote-share draws.
primary_scoring.winner: the system with the lower arithmetic mean fair CRPS over the fixed eight-party order
primary_scoring.tie_rule: exact equality at the machine-readable reported precision is a tie

secondary_scoring.finite_ensemble_v_statistic: Reported only as a labeled sensitivity metric, never substituted for the primary fair score.
secondary_scoring.point_mae: MAE over the eight actual published central predictions; the benchmark must not choose mean versus median after results are known.
secondary_scoring.central_intervals: Coverage and width are reported only for genuinely compatible published central interval levels.
secondary_scoring.seats: Scored only if both systems provide genuine predictive seat distributions with compatible semantics.
secondary_scoring.government_majority: Scored only when event definitions are proven identical.

campaign_scoring.dates: all paired eligible scheduled captures from 2026-09-04 through 2026-09-12
campaign_scoring.weighting: equal weight per scheduled capture date and equal weight per party within a date
reports: equal-weight mean score across paired eligible dates
number of dates won by each system
paired eligible date count and all exclusion reasons
campaign_scoring.intraday_weighting: At most one capture per scheduled date; additional model updates receive no additional weight.

fallback_hierarchy.condition: verified election-day predictive draws for both systems
fallback_hierarchy.decision: declare probabilistic winner by mean fair CRPS

fallback_hierarchy.condition: no mutually verified draws, but both systems have a published median and at least one genuinely compatible central interval level from the predeclared set 50%, 80%, 90%, 95%
fallback_hierarchy.decision: declare probabilistic winner by mean WIS over the intersection of those levels, using all and only the common levels
fallback_hierarchy.wis_formula: For common alpha levels, WIS = (0.5*|y-m| + sum_k (alpha_k/2)*IS_alpha_k)/(0.5 + sum_k alpha_k/2), where IS_alpha=(u-l)+(2/alpha)*(l-y)1[y<l]+(2/alpha)*(y-u)1[y>u].

fallback_hierarchy.condition: neither A nor B is supported
fallback_hierarchy.decision: do not declare a probabilistic winner; compare point forecasts by eight-party MAE

threshold_events.event: official national valid-vote share >= 4.0 percentage points
threshold_events.requires: a genuinely published or verified-draw-derived probability from both systems
threshold_events.highlight: L is pre-registered for explicit discussion; all four events are scored when comparable.
